paite: Huan Josiah in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in Paikan Ankuang abawl a; akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou hi.
heading: Josiah In Paikan Kut Alawm / (2 Kum 23.21-23)

paite: Huchi in siampute anasep uh asehsak a, TOUPA' inn a nasepna sem ding in ahanthawn hi.

Israel mite sinsakmi, Pathian a ding a hihtuam Levite kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon inn lam ah bawm siangthou koih un; na liangzang ua zawn akiphamohta kei ding; TOUPA na Pathian uh leh ami Israelte nna semta un.
Israel kumpipa David gelh bang leh atapa Solomon gelh bang in na inkuan vaihawm makai dungzui zel un apawlpawl in kisa un.
Na unaute uh inkuan vaihawm makai dungzui zel in Levite tuam a tantuan nei in mun siangthou ah om un.
Paikan Ankuangluina ding gou unla, kihihsiangthou unla, Mosi zang a TOUPA gen bang hih ding in na unaute uh ding in bawl un," achi hi.
Huchi in Josiah in huai a mi om tengteng Paikan Ankuang a dia lan ding in ganhon lak a belamnou leh kelnou singthum leh bawngtal sangthum apia a: huaite kumpipa sum lak a ahi.

Amiliante'n mipite, siampute, Levite amau ut thu a lan ding in apia uhi. Pathian inn a heutu, Hilkiah, Zekariah leh Jehielte'n Paikan Ankuang dia lan ding in ganta nou sangnih-le-zaguk leh bawngtal zathum siampute apia uhi.
Konaniah, a-unau Shemaiah leh Nethaneel, Levite heutu Hashabiah, Zeiel leh Jozabadte'n leng Paikan Ankuang dia lat ding in Levite ganta nou sangnga leh bawngtal zanga apia uhi.
Huchi in nasepna abawl ua, kumpipa thupiak bang in siampute amun uah adingh ua, Levite apawldan bang zel un.
Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou ua, siampute'n sisan atheh ua, Levite'n avun ahawk uhi.
Huan Mosi laibu a tuang bang a inkuan khendan dungzui zel a TOUPA kiang a lat ding a piak ding in halmang thillatte alasawn ua. Bawngtalte leng huchi mah bang in ahih uhi.
Huchi in Paikan Ankuangluina ding a dan bang in a-em min ua; thillat siangthousa bel, bel khaina nei, belgongza in a-ui ua, mi tengteng kiang ah apaipih uhi.
Huai khit in amau leh siampute a ding abawl ua; Aaron ta siampute halmang thillat leh sathau lan in zan tanpha in abuai ngal ua; huaiziak in Levite'n amau leh Aaron ta siampute a ding abawl uhi.

David, Asaph, Heman leh kumpipa zawlnei Jeduthunte thupiak bang in lasami Ashaph tapate amun uah adingh ua, kongkhak ngak mite bel kongkhak chih ah a-om ua; a-unau Levite'n abawlsak ziak un a-nna uh paisan akiphamoh kei hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Josiah thupiak bang a Paikan Ankuang lui ding leh TOUPA maitam a halmang thillat lan ding in huai ni mah in TOUPA nasepna thil tengteng abawl uhi.
Huchi in huai lai a Israel suan omte'n huai ni in Paikan Ankuang abawl ua, tanghou silngou soh louh ankuang leng ni sagih abawl lai uhi.

Zawlnei Samuel dam lai a kipan Israel gam ah Paikan Ankuang huchibang himhim abawl ngei kei ua; Israel kumpipa kuamah in Josiah leh siampute leh Levite leh Judah tengteng leh Israelte'n aneih bang uh nei a-om sam kei uhi.
Kum sawm-le-giat Josiah vaihawm kum in huai Paikan Ankuangluina zat in a-om hi.
Huai tengteng khit a Josiah in tempul abawl khit in, Karkhemish sual ding in Euphrates Luipi ah Aigupta kumpipa Neko apaitou a; Josiah in amah ava sual hi.
heading: Josiah Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna / (2 Kum 23.28-30)

paite: Himahleh, ama'n, "Judah kumpipa, ei gel i kisaikhakna bang om ahia? Nang sual ding in ka hong pai kei a, ka dousa dou ding a hong ka hi zaw, Pathian in kinoh ding in thu ahon pia a, ka lam a pang Pathian doudal kei in, ahon hihmang kha ding," chi in palai asawl hi.
Himahleh Josiah in akiksan nuam kei a, adou theihna ding in akibawl lamdang a, Pathian kam a kipan a Neko thugen apom kei a, Meggiddo Phaizang ah na sual ding in akuan hi.
Huchi in thalkap mite'n Josiah akapkha ua; kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, "Hon paimangpih un, liamna thupi mahmah ka tuakta," achi hi.
Huchi in asikhate'n kangtalai a kipan alakhia ua, akangtalai dang ah akoih ua, Jerusalem ah apaipih ua, asi a, api-le-pute han ah avui uhi. Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mite'n Josiah asuun uhi.
Huan Jeremiah in Josiah akah a; lasami numei leh pasalte'n tutan in Josiah akahna la uh agen lailai uhi. Israel gam ah dan in anei ua, ngai dih, kahna la ah huai atuangta hi.
Josiah thilhih dang tengteng, athilhih hoihte, TOUPA Dan Bu a kigelh bang zel in,
amasapen leh ananungpente leng, ngai dih, Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipate tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om uhi.
